finding: 9 of 9 factors have the same sign for full-control mean Rank IC and mean M3 Fama-MacBeth beta.
interpretation: Rank-based and conditional-linear return evidence can therefore be compared directly for most factors, while disagreements should be treated as mixed evidence.

finding: 3 factors preserve the same direction across W60/W120/W252 for all four future-risk targets.
interpretation: Risk evidence is assessed separately from return evidence and is not reduced to a single Alpha criterion.

finding: 5 of 9 factors are classified as HIGH_COST_SENSITIVITY under the fixed Step-5 descriptive rule.
interpretation: Statistical predictability and economic implementability are treated as separate dimensions.

finding: Mean round-trip traded-notional ratio is 1.551 for level/structural variables and 2.958 for one-month dynamic variables.
interpretation: Short-horizon network dynamics require more portfolio rebalancing on average.
The final research output is a role-based evidence map rather than a best-to-worst factor ranking.
